title.narrative: Improving living conditions and resilience of refugees displaced by the Syrian crisis and vulnerable hosting communities in Lebanon- ILO

description.narrative:
Overall objective: To improve the living conditions and the resilience of refugees displaced by the Syrian crisis and vulnerable hosting communities in Lebanon.

Specific objective:

Increase the access, with a gender sensitive focus, to livelihoods opportunities for the self-reliance of refugees and vulnerable host communities

Outputs:  

1.      Employment-oriented services provided to vulnerable households, including households benefiting from social assistance and social services interventions.

2.      Local priority projects are implemented to promote short-term employment opportunities and social stability.

Beneficiaries: Refugees and host communities in Lebanon, particularly women, youths and people with disabilities
